g.text: MinVelRank1Convo1 begins.
MomToxicated: What's happened to her? I need answers.
MomToxicated: Real answers. And none of this "it's hard to explain" bullshit the other ones are giving me.
Lol.
Hi?
Um.
And this is...?
PapaPolar: no reason to be like that. start with a "hi, how are ya?"
PapaPolar: sorry, pal. when M's got a target in sight, it's all about the Go Go Go.
MomToxicated: And I don't need YOU undercutting me.
PapaPolar: i'm not?
MomToxicated: Hah. Yeah. Right. Like you weren't undercutting me in Yalchesko.
Minerva & Velimir, I assume?
Okay... Can we back up, please? What's going on?
PapaPolar: yeah. sorry. hi. i was probably the easy one to guess, huh? lol
PapaPolar: hah! sorry, pal. velimir. and MomToxicated over here is minerva.
PapaPolar: MomToxicated over here is minerva.
MomToxicated: VELIMIR. What is the POINT of using this asset if YOU JUST -
MomToxicated: DAMN IT.
PapaPolar: M, be reasonable. process of elimination. how many of us freaks can there reasonably be on this system?
I get the feeling there are going to just end up being more and more as time goes on.
Can you two sort out whatever is happening and *then* come talk to me?
I am so extremely confused.
Update boolean VelimirFamily1
PapaPolar: fear you'll be waiting a long time then, pal. hah.
PapaPolar: well, if *you're* confused, then we're all screwed. hah!
+5 Chemistry
PapaPolar: here's the short of it. M here has questions she wants answers to, and wants you to answer them.
PapaPolar: seeing as you're the one we've come here to get answers from.
PapaPolar: i for one hope so! the more the merrier, i say. s'like the old saying goes, the only difference between a cult and a religion is numbers, haha.
PapaPolar: there. that better, M? that suit your "good cop/bad cop" gameplan more?
PapaPolar: is that a saying?
MomToxicated: Sol above, I'm going to scream...
PapaPolar: i don't know. you get where i'm going. water's great, everybody in, as far as i'm concerned! well, anyway.
Why do I get the feeling I'm being interrogated?
Well. Um. I'd rather if you didn't try to "game" the conversation with me.
What do you have questions about? I'll help if I can.
MomToxicated: Not a word, Velimir.
MomToxicated: This is anything but a game.
MomToxicated: Your cooperation has been noted, "Drifter."
PapaPolar: :-X
MomToxicated: Are you going to answer my questions? Yes or no?
MomToxicated: If that is your real name.
MomToxicated: Like dealing with - whatever. Whatever. It doesn't matter.
Nah, sorry. I don't like your attitude, lady.
Okay, fine. What is it?
PapaPolar: (i don't think we get to judge.)
MomToxicated: A mistake. I will give you some time to think it over and reconsider.
MomToxicated: VELIMIR
+20 Chemistry
PapaPolar: :-X

MomToxicated: Sigh...
Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank1Convo2.
MomToxicated: Drifter.
MomToxicated: One simple question answered, and we will be on our way:
MomToxicated: What has happened to Major Neci Rusalka?
It's... complicated?
I... don't know.
MomToxicated: "COMPLICATED."
MomToxicated: You "DON'T KNOW."
PapaPolar: oh, here we go...
MomToxicated: Drifter. You and I will continue this tomorrow. Velimir. You. Me. A word. Offline.
MomToxicated: NOW.
Update boolean MinervaNeci1
+20 Chemistry
